# PanX

> PanX is Waleed Sadek's one-person product studio: small tools for problems people face alone, one at a time, since 2017. Founded in the UK as a consultancy, run from Egypt since, built in public.

## What it makes

- Tafadal (https://tafadal.app): an AI front desk and follow-up list for coaches and consultants who work alone. The website chat answers visitors from the owner's own text, in their language, at any hour. Everyone from the chat, email and bookings lands in one list; people selling rather than buying are moved aside, and each follow-up is drafted in the owner's words and sent only when they press send. Live, 2026.
- Badge wall (on ToolSeekr): a ready-made "featured on" badge section for founders whose free directory listings require a badge. 2025.
- ToolSeekr (https://toolseekr.com): a curated business-software directory in English and Arabic, built with indie makers. 2024.
- awesome-certificates (https://panx.io/awesome-certificates/ and https://github.com/PanXProject/awesome-certificates): a community list of free courses that come with a certificate, nearly 6,000 GitHub stars. 2020.
- Earlier: Xposure (multi-location Google Maps listings, 2022, retired), Hunt (a job search engine over many countries' boards, 2019), HireUps (hiring meetups, 2018).
